name: Rock Bottom

features.name: Stage progression
features.description: Each stage expands a character to four high.

features.name: Headshrinker and Insanity Spins
features.description: Two bonus tiers with five stages.

review:
Rock Bottom is a tribal-themed slot. Three or four scatters start Headshrinker Spins, and more lead to Insanity Spins. Both run through five stages, and each stage turns one character symbol into a four-high stack.

xCap and xSplit add further twists. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 19,690x cap and a 31% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
